symptom: A migration version guard passes locally but its version measurement disappears when the hosted release suppresses child process output, including on failure.
rule: Test the actual subprocess boundary and carry only a validated version number to the release log on both success and refusal; never expose arbitrary driver diagnostics.
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config scripts/release/vitest.config.ts scripts/release/migration-command.test.ts scripts/release/migration-cli.test.ts
